note: Sonoma County regional park on the Doran Beach sand spit at Bodega Bay. Shell, Gull and Cove loops sit on the harbor side of the park road behind dunes; the Jetty loop is on the bay side at the jetty end; Miwok is tent-only. Stays are capped at 30 nights a calendar year. Very high tides can close the park. --Claude
summary: Doran Regional Park (Sonoma County): open year-round; $41 + tax confirmed, $10 reservation fee, extra vehicle $10 (the +$13 electric rate doesn't apply, no hookups); flush toilets, coin showers, water spigots, dump $10; reservation only, 6 months, max 10 consecutive nights. The 31-ft max (Spring Lake/Stillwater) cleared. Coastal dunes confirmed. Phone empty -> (707) 875-3540. Booking engine behind a captcha, unread.
